Clipper2 2.0.1 (https://github.com/AngusJohnson/Clipper2, tag Clipper2_2.0.1), Boost Software License 1.0.
The C++ library only (CPP/Clipper2Lib), unmodified; its triangulation (a beta in this release) is not compiled
(clipper.triangulation.cpp left out). Used by the navmesh builder for polygon booleans and offsets.
